NHS has no enzymatic activity and no GO molecular function annotation; its known activity is binding, through its WAVE homology domain, the WAVE regulatory complex subunits that it assembles into a WAVE shell complex (evidence on the downstream node Loss of NHS WAVE Shell Complex), which is the function bound here as decreased.
